events.message: Reproducing the signup journey in Chromium.
Asking NVIDIA Nemotron for a component patch (attempt 1/1).
Replaying the unchanged checks against candidate 1.
The candidate passed every automated check. The patch is ready for human review.

attempts.rationale: Added proper labels with htmlFor/id, converted submit to native button, used refs for focus management, error state as object with field/message, set aria-invalid and aria-describedby, added live region for announcements, kept validation logic and onSubmit signature unchanged.

checks.name: Fields have accessible labels
checks.detail: Email, password and consent can be identified by their accessible names.

checks.name: Complete signup using only the keyboard
checks.detail: Tab → email → password → consent → Enter reached the confirmation screen.

checks.name: Validation errors are announced and linked
checks.detail: All three invalid fields expose their state, associated error text, and a live message.

checks.name: Focus moves to the first invalid field
checks.detail: Submit moves focus to email, password or consent according to the first error.

checks.name: Valid signup still submits the correct data
checks.detail: One submission contains the original email, password and explicit consent.

checks.name: Malformed email is rejected
checks.detail: Malformed email cannot create an account.

checks.name: Short passwords are rejected
checks.detail: A password shorter than 8 characters cannot create an account.

checks.name: Consent is required before signup
checks.detail: Unchecked consent blocks the submission.

checks.name: Automated accessibility scan
checks.detail: No axe violations found in the initial and invalid states for the selected WCAG tags.

checks.name: Component renders without runtime errors
checks.detail: No browser page errors during the journey.

summary: The candidate passed every automated check. The patch is ready for human review.
humanChecks: Screen reader announcements and reading order need manual testing with assistive technology.
